audience: teams that run digital signage screens with AbleSign

useCases.title: See which screens are online
useCases.text: List the screens with their orientation, online state, group and tags. Open one screen to read its settings.

useCases.title: Check what one screen plays
useCases.text: Read the playlist of one screen, with the duration, transition and schedule of each item.

useCases.title: Find the media that played most
useCases.text: Summarize plays per media file or web app for one period. Then see how one asset played on each screen.

useCases.title: Organize media into folders
useCases.text: Create a media folder, optionally inside a parent folder. Rename a folder to change its title.

useCases.title: Add a video to a screen playlist
useCases.text: Find the media file, then add it to the playlist of one screen. The content plays on the live screen.
